title: Notice on Binance Spot Block Matching API Update (2025-06-27)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance is thrilled to announce the availability of API functionality for  Spot Block Matching  starting from 2025-06-27 (UTC).  For more details, please refer to the  SAPI Doc  or in our  API portal .  Key Updates Place Spot Block Match Order Order Place(TRADE) POST /sapi/v1/block-match/order/place Accept Order, Complete Transaction Order Take(TRADE) POST /sapi/v1/block-match/order/take Cancel Open Order Order Cancel(TRADE) POST /sapi/v1/block-match/order/cancel Extend Order Validity Period by Adding 30 Minutes to the Current Time Order Extend(TRADE) POST /sapi/v1/block-match/order/extend Return Trading Symbols Supported by Block Match Symbols(USER_DATA) POST /sapi/v1/block-match/symbols Query User's Open Orders Query open order(USER_DATA) POST /sapi/v1/block-match/order/query-open-order Query User's Order History Query Order History(USER_DATA) POST /sapi/v1/block-match/order/query-order-history Notes Trading will  not  be impacted by the aforementioned updates.  Spot Block Matching is a whitelist-only product accessible through the  VIP Portal . For whitelisting requests, please contact either (i) your sales / key account Spot coverage team; or (ii)  vip@binance.com . Available trading pairs are subject to continuous review by Binance and will be based on user feedback.  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-06-27
